description: N2 of the Codex review of the commit that allowed neither a FAIL nor a silence without certainty: `from unittest import skipIf as print`, and the file's own `skip` calls `print(True, reason)`. `skip` is a function of the module, not an import of unittest: TG003 warns that `@skip` may skip `test_adds`, never silence. The real runner skips the test.
